problemSigns.sign: Opener hums but the door doesn't move
problemSigns.detail: This often points to a stripped drive gear or a disconnected trolley assembly inside the opener unit.

problemSigns.sign: Door reverses before touching the floor
problemSigns.detail: This usually indicates a misaligned or faulty safety sensor, or an incorrectly set down-limit switch.
The issue could be dead batteries, interference, a damaged logic board, or a need for reprogramming.
Blinking lights signal an obstruction, misalignment, or a damaged wire connecting the safety sensors to the opener.

problemSigns.sign: Trolley moves but door stays down
problemSigns.detail: This typically means the emergency release cord has been pulled, disengaging the door from the opener trolley.
